thread:
Carla: Quick sync — saw 3 support tickets about accidental API key revokes. Can we discuss an 'Undo' affordance or softer revoke flow? Not asking for full rollback, just a short window to restore.

Ben: Do we mean an undo after the revoke confirmation modal, or a pre-confirmation safer flow? Right now we mark revoked and it's immediate.

Maria_design: My bias is a small toast with 'Undo' for 10–30s + a permanent revocation option in the audit log. I dropped a quick mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/revoke-undo (internal). Thoughts on copy? :mag: 

Sam_engineer: Backend note: we currently set status='revoked' and that immediately disables tokens. We can implement a 'soft_revoked' state with a TTL to allow reactivation within X seconds, then finalize. Adds some job lifecycle work but doable.

Dan_accessibility: If we add a toast it needs to be keyboard reachable and announced. Use aria-live='polite' for the toast content and ensure the Undo button is in the tab order. Also ensure focus isn't lost for screen reader users.

Ben: :thinking_face: Security concern — an undo window could be abused if an attacker triggers a revoke and then user clicks undo unknowingly. Maybe restrict undo to owner role or require a confirmation for privileged keys?

Carla: Support context — 3 tickets this week, one was a junior dev who clicked too fast. A 30s undo would have prevented two of them. Not seeing evidence of targeted abuse.

Maria_design: Proposed toast copy: "API key revoked. [Undo] • View in audit log." For the modal, update primary copy: "Revoking this key stops all requests immediately. To temporarily pause usage, consider rotating instead." Quick alt copy suggestions below.

Sam_engineer: Implementation sketch: POST /v1/keys/{id}/revoke -> mark status='soft_revoked', emit event, schedule final_revocation job at +TTL. Undo endpoint: POST /v1/keys/{id}/undo_revoke cancels job and flips to 'active'. Need idempotency and to log audit event. Example snippet: ```http
POST /v1/keys/ak_123/revoke
Response 202 { "status": "soft_revoked", "finalizes_at": "2025-11-05T12:00:00Z" }
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created feature flag 'revoke-undo' in FF service. Suggested rollout: internal staff -> 10% -> 100% after metrics.

Dan_accessibility: Small nit on copy contrast for the Undo button — if it's inline text it may fail contrast for small sizes. Make it a visible button (icon + label) and aim for 4.5:1 for accessibility. Also ensure ARIA role=alert when final state happens.

Maria_design: Agree on button. Mobile note: toast placement — top-center blocks nav; propose bottom-right on desktop, bottom-center on mobile. I'll update frames.

Ben: OK if we do 30s TTL + restrict undo to owner/editor roles? Sam, any perf or storage concerns from holding tombstones for 30s–24h?

Sam_engineer: 30s is trivial. Even 24h TTL is fine if tombstones are compact and we run scheduled cleanup. We'll also add metrics: undo_count, finalize_count, revoke_rate.

Carla: Next steps: Maria to update Figma + provide exact copy options, Sam to prototype endpoints + FF, Dan to add ARIA checklist, I'll file a ticket and tag support to monitor. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Maria_design: I'll post updated frames and a short copy doc here when ready.

Sam_engineer: I'll spin up a quick API prototype and share some curl examples.

Ben: Put a quick UX/security run in design review tomorrow.

Carla: filing ticket now and pinging @support.
